goal: Training yourself to read the structure, understand the flow, and identify where modifications are needed, rather than writing a lot of Python code yourself

levels.title: Single Syntax / Single Function Reading
levels.goal: Let's explore the meaning of a single line of code.

levels.title: Variables + Functions: Connections
levels.goal: Understand the flow where a value is assigned to a variable and the program moves on to the next line.

levels.title: Retrieving Values from Data Structures
levels.goal: Understand the basic structures of lists, dictionaries, sets, and tuples.

levels.title: Understanding the Flow of Conditional and Loop Statements
levels.goal: Read the flowchart that shows how to select the value that meets the conditions from among several options.

levels.title: Reading the Flow of Function Links
levels.goal: It traces the flow of function input values, internal processing, and return values.

levels.title: Read File + Convert to JSON
levels.goal: Open the file, read the lines, and follow the process of converting JSON/JSONL to a dictionary.

levels.title: Input → Processing → Output Pipeline
levels.goal: Read the "load, filter, write, main" structure and summarize its overall functionality.

levels.title: Function Inference from a List of Functions
levels.goal: Infer the purpose of the program by looking at the function names and the list of imports.

levels.title: Selecting the Functions Needed for the Functional Goals
levels.goal: From a PM perspective, select the combination of modules and functions required to implement the feature.

levels.title: PM-Style Code Review
levels.goal: Identifies potential failures, missing exception handling, security risks, and operational risks.
